question: Who has written the book 'The philosophy of the bomb?'
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagwati Charan Vohra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhagwati Charan Vohra, a prominent member of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (**HSRA**), wrote "The Philosophy of the Bomb" in **1929**.
 
• It was written to defend the revolutionary methods adopted by **Bhagat Singh** and others, especially after the public debates following the bombing of the Central Legislative Assembly by Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt.
 
• It outlined the rationale behind revolutionary violence as a means to attain freedom, arguing that peaceful methods had failed to make a significant impact.
 
• It aimed to inspire the youth and justify the actions taken by HSRA in their fight against British rule.
